answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 12275 Country: India Title: Dear mufti saheb assalam alaikum,i have committed zina many times with my very close relative,i have repented an many times and asked tauba,but since she is also living in the same house,as iam, whenever i see her and talk to her my bad feelings overcome me and start to indulge in zina, i cannot stop it and im not in state to move out of my house also, im married and she is also married, please give remedies for this disease of mine,wassalam Question: Dear mufti saheb assalam alaikum,i have committed zina many times with my very close relative,i have repented an many times and asked tauba,but since she is also living in the same house,as iam, whenever i see her and talk to her my bad feelings overcome me and start to indulge in zina, i cannot stop it and im not in state to move out of my house also, im married and she is also married, please give remedies for this disease of mine,wassalam Answer ID: 12275 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 688\688=M/1430) Perform two rak?ah salah of repentance and beseech Allah for your forgiveness. Feel regret for what you have done, make firm determination not to commit the sin again and ask forgiveness from Allah. Recall the punishments and torment promised by Allah. Keep yourself away (in purdah) from the relative woman and have no relation with her. Avoid the things as well which lead to the sin. This depends upon your courage and persistent determination. May Allah give you taufeeq to shun the sins. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
